title: Purchase-Volume Bonus on Northgate+ Business Cash
content:
**Volume table.** Businesses that buy more from Northgate earn more Northgate Cash: under the Business earning schedule of Northgate Rewards and Northgate+ Memberships, the business's purchasing volume adds percentage points to the Business earning percentage of the line the schedule settles. The volume is the total of the net amounts of the lines on the member's Northgate orders on Northgate Store and Online Orders dated within the twelve whole calendar months before today, that is, dated on a day from which fewer than twelve whole calendar months have passed by today.

| Total net amount of those lines (USD) | Points added |
|---|---|
| 5000 or more | 0.5 |
| 2000 to less than 5000 | 0.25 |
| less than 2000 | none |

**Both sides of each threshold (hypothetical totals)**

| Total | Points added |
|---|---|
| 5000.00 | 0.5 |
| 4999.99 | 0.25 |
| 2000.00 | 0.25 |
| 1999.99 | none |
